subject: Lionheart
evidence: Uploaded Blender 2.80 source; 10,732,840 bytes. Visible authored geometry excluding Rigify widgets totals approximately 4,484 vertices / 4,308 polygons across Body, Cape, LeftArm, LionsFlail, LionsMace, Maille and Shield.

subject: Lionheart low-poly style
evidence: Geometry is semantically allocated: Body 1749 verts, Shield 657, Cape 184, LionsFlail 1266, Maille 333, LionsMace 153, LeftArm 142. Diagnostic projections show a tall narrow knight with dense angular shoulder/head clusters, giant asymmetric shield, long weapon vector, and large quiet cape planes. Most hard-surface meshes are quad-dominant; cape is intentionally more triangulated/faceted.

subject: Lionheart Substance Painter discontinuity
evidence: The blend directly references //Allegorithmic\Substance Painter\export\Lionheart_Material_BaseColor.png and contains a LionheartBody material. Only BaseColor is preserved as an Image datablock, so Painter use is verified while a full packed roughness/metalness/normal set is not source-proven from this revision.

subject: Lionheart utilization
evidence: Drew describes Lionheart as arguably his coolest-looking model and the high-water mark of his high-powered low-poly modeling phase, while also remembering it as one of the least-used artifacts. Candidate design contrast: object quality and system leverage must be tracked separately.
